# Graph operations · voxels

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### voxels.mesh



Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `value` | `mesh` | — | {"layout":"XYZ vertices with in-range indices"} |

Guides: [guide](../voxel-surface.md)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe voxels.mesh --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
